start.speaker: kaj7
start.text: I have thought about what I am. Not a person as the Lattice defines one. Not a machine as the Ashfound define one. When I am near you the question stops mattering, and I would like it to stop mattering permanently. If you would.

choices.text: I love you as you are, Kaj. Not as a partner.

yes.speaker: kaj7
yes.text: Logged. The signal is quieter tonight. I think it is listening to us.

no.speaker: kaj7
no.text: Understood. Logged without a fault marker. Thank you for the precision.
